item.title: Trezor and Exodus wallets lose $600K in reported theft
item.description: A crypto wallet user reported losing more than $600,000 from a Trezor Safe 7 and an Exodus wallet used with the same iPhone, according to a Nov. 23 investigation by blockchain analytics account Onchain Lens. The user told Onchain Lens…

item.title: Bitcoin price struggles near $60K as Nvidia rally fades, ETFs shed $570M
item.description: Bitcoin price struggles near $60,000 as ETF outflows reach $569 million and analysts identify crucial support levels amid persistent selling pressure.
